51470033.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to NTMT1 (unknown origin) assessed as dissociation constant in presence of SAM by isothermal titration calorimetry analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) experiments were performed on a MicroCal iTC200 instrument (Malvern Panalytical) at 25 °C. NTMT1 (10 μM) was loaded into the sample cell, and YD206 (100 μM) was loaded into the syringe. The buffer used was 20 mM HEPES (pH 7.5), 100 mM NaCl, 1 mM DTT, and 0.01% Tween-20. The experiment consisted of 29 injections of 2 μL each, with a 120 s spacing between injections. The data were analyzed using Origin 7.0 software (OriginLab) with a one-site binding model. A control experiment was performed by titrating YD206 into buffer alone to subtract the heat of dilution.
original_paragraph.Figure 2 caption: Representative ITC data of YD206 bound to NTMT1 in the absence of SAM (E) and in the presence of SAM (F). All the experiments were performed in duplicate (n = 2).
original_paragraph.Figure 2E: N = 0.992, Kd = 160 ± 43.7 nM, ΔH = -7.14 ± 0.278 Kcal/mol, ΔG = -9.28 Kcal/mol, -TΔS = -2.41 Kcal/mol
original_paragraph.Figure 2F: N = 1.05, Kd = 32.5 ± 6.04 nM, ΔH = -12.6 ± 0.199 Kcal/mol, ΔG = -10.2 Kcal/mol, -TΔS = 2.41 Kcal/mol

assay_conditions.buffer_composition: 20 mM HEPES, 100 mM NaCl, 1 mM DTT, 0.01% Tween-20
assay_conditions.control_method: Titration of YD206 into buffer alone to subtract the heat of dilution
